title: AI after 50: the complete guide to using it well and not being fooled by it

posts.facebook:
An AI assistant is a fluent helper that is sometimes wrong. Use it for drafts, check what matters, keep secrets out.

A start-here guide to AI for people over 50: what an AI assistant is, what it does well and badly, how to hold a first conversation, how to check its answers, what to keep private, how to use it before a health appointment and how to see through voice clones, deepfakes and fake reviews. It ends with free places to learn in the UK and US and a seven-day plan.

Treat an AI assistant as a quick, well-read helper whose work you check, and treat any urgent voice or video asking for money as unproven.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/ai/ai-after-50-the-complete-guide/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
